caption: The drawing depicts a pitcher composed of two distinct sections. The upper portion of the pitcher is cylindrical and decorated with a floral motif, featuring a pink flower with a yellow center and green leaves on a light, creamy background. The rim of the pitcher is outlined in yellow, and the inner part is also filled in yellow. The handle, attached to the upper section and extending down, is brown. The lower half of the pitcher is bulbous and covered with a crosshatched, basket-like pattern in shades of brown, giving it a textured appearance. The overall composition is centered on a plain, unadorned background. There are light pencil notes and small marks visible on the paper around the edges of the drawing.
title: Majolica Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
